primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen opens already in follow mode on hub dws_trade (default trail, app.js:97 and app.js:665): upstream edges cyan / downstream orange with edge labels on canvas, and 上游依赖/下游影响 follow lists dominating the inspector (screenshots) — the brief's primary job (follow dependencies/impacts) is the dominant pre-arranged state, no clicks needed.

Label proxy: not a human measurement.

navigation_cost.evidence: Single screen; primary object reachable in one interaction: node click follow (app.js:257), edge click select (app.js:223), inspector follow buttons (app.js:479-490), breadcrumb jump (app.js:589-593), search via '/' + arrows + Enter (app.js:630-642), depth toggle 1跳/2跳/全链路 (index.html:21-25), shortcuts Backspace/Esc/1/2/0 (app.js:645-658).

context_loss.evidence: Acceptance seed implemented literally: non-related content dimmed but never removed (node opacity 0.12 app.js:296-297, edge opacity 0.14 app.js:343); context badge in both screenshots reads '24 对象 / 33 关系均可见 ｜ 高亮 14 节点 · 15 关系 ｜ 其余弱化保留' (app.js:388-390); breadcrumb + 回退/全景 preserve the followed path (index.html:48-51); state serialized to URL hash (app.js:125-134).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly the task needs: topbar (search, depth segment, 4 type chips), canvas + trail bar + context badge + legend, inspector (index.html:10-62). No decorative or unused controls, one main screen per brief constraint.

frontend_rework.evidence: Layout receipt checks all pass (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation) and no layout breakage visible at either viewport; but 2 of 7 checks fail implying rework: a11y.contrast and type.min_projected_size — 11.5px SVG labels in a 1200x840 viewBox project ≈8-9px at 1280 where the graph pane is ~908px wide (styles.css:136, index.html:31, screenshot 1280x860); minor stacked-label clutter in the dense center at 1280.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' addressed explicitly: stated in the page title (index.html:6), articulated by the context badge ('均可见/弱化保留'), enforced by dim-not-remove rendering (app.js:296-297,343); success criterion '依赖与影响可跟随' covered by directional 1-hop follow lists, depth control, per-edge direction detail '本 ⟶ 对端 / 对端 ⟶ 本' (app.js:477-502), and orientation-stable layout (app.js:2-3).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast: fail (measurement-summary.json) — low-contrast secondary text (#66739a on dark panels, styles.css:10) and heavily dimmed context nodes (opacity 0.12, app.js:296) make弱化 content borderline legible
type.min_projected_size: fail — SVG node/edge labels 10.5-11.5px inside a 1200x840 viewBox shrink below minimum when projected at 1280x860 (styles.css:136,144; index.html:31)
Minor graph-label clutter at 1280x860: stacked edge labels (e.g. '派生计算' ×2) and node labels overlapping edges in the dense center of the layout
scores.overall_note: impl-09 delivers a directed dependency network whose primary job — following dependencies and impacts without losing global context — is the default screen state rather than a mode the user must find: the app opens focused on hub dws_trade with cyan upstream / orange downstream highlighting, one-click follow lists, a breadcrumb of the followed path, and a context badge asserting all 24 objects / 33 relations remain visible while unrelated content is dimmed, not removed (app.js:296-297,343,388-390; screenshots at both viewports). Relationships are treated as first-class content (clickable edges with a relation inspector, app.js:404-425), navigation is single-screen with keyboard shortcuts and URL-hash state, and the permanent UI is tight against the task's needs. The two receipt failures are both legibility-related — contrast (consistent with #66739a secondary text and 0.12-opacity dimmed nodes) and minimum projected type size (11.5px labels scaled down inside the SVG) — while overflow, collision, truncation, focus order, and target size all pass. time_to_understand is a model-judged proxy only, and no human preference can be inferred from these artifacts.
